_comment: Held-out evaluation set. These questions were written from the archive's own records AFTER the retrieval and reasoning rules were implemented, and no rule was added or tuned to make any of them pass. They exist to measure general capability — whether an unseen judge question in a familiar *shape* is answered — rather than success on the questions we developed against. `expect` is a substring the answer must contain. `expect_status` constrains the completion state, so an honest refusal counts as a pass where the archive genuinely lacks the evidence. Categories map to the reasoning operations the system claims to support.
